task_summary: KRAS follow-ups: 3-reader PIK3CA-matched replication, pathologist packet, slide model

steps.title: Build PIK3CA-matched pair set
steps.description: Re-pair all 184 colorectal MSS KRAS-mutant patients 1:1 with KRAS/BRAF wild-type MSS controls from the same hospital AND with the same PIK3CA status, no control reused (~129 pairs expected), stage and age as tie-breakers. This single set answers both 'match on PIK3CA' and 'three readers per pair'.

steps.title: Extract 48 candidate fields per slide
steps.description: Run the validated sampler (extract_kras_full.py v3, red-OD top-20%) on every slide in the new set with 48 candidates per slide, so each slide can supply three non-overlapping 8-field reader sets.

steps.title: Screen fields for tumour epithelium
steps.description: Blind per-slide tumour/epithelium screen of every field (same labels as before), with field-overlap checks; keep pairs with >=24 non-overlapping tumour fields on both slides, falling back to 6 fields per reader if needed, declared as a deviation.

steps.title: Package three disjoint reader sets
steps.description: Randomise and seal A/B per pair, then build three reader archives (reader 1/2/3) of spatially non-overlapping fields plus overviews, saved as artifacts with the key and an eligibility table.

steps.title: Select 30 slides for spot-check
steps.description: Pick 30 of the 232 graded slides, stratified so the three features that differed between arms (mucinous %, serrated, dirty necrosis) and differentiation span their range, and both arms are represented.

steps.title: Build blinded packet and sheet
steps.description: Produce a PDF with one page per anonymised slide (8 fields + overview, scale bar), and an Excel grading sheet with the same fields and dropdowns the sub-agent graders used, no KRAS or pair information.

steps.title: Write agreement-scoring script
steps.description: Script that reads the returned sheet and reports weighted kappa / Spearman per feature versus the blinded sub-agent grades, ready to run once a pathologist fills it in.

steps.title: Check embedding run status
steps.description: Read-only check of the four Modal embedding jobs and count UNI and Phikon feature files present for the 443 colorectal MSS slides; wait for completion if still running.

steps.title: Quote and launch ABMIL training job
steps.description: Write a T4 job that trains attention-MIL on UNI features (primary; Phikon secondary given its TCGA pretraining) for KRAS-mutant vs wild-type over all colorectal MSS patients with patient-level 5-fold CV stratified by hospital; quote cost and ask for approval before launching.

steps.title: Score model on reader pairs
steps.description: Using out-of-fold predictions only, compute slide-level AUROC and pairwise accuracy on the 116 original pairs and the new PIK3CA-matched pairs, so the model is compared to readers on exactly the same pairs.

steps.title: Dispatch three readers per pair
steps.description: One no-hint reader sub-agent per pair per field set (about 390 readers) using the same prompt and output schema as the 116-pair run, in waves of 48.

steps.title: Audit reader deviations
steps.description: Collect all results, tabulate declared deviations (unseen fields, downsampled viewing) and flag readers whose coverage falls below 12 of 16 fields.

steps.title: Unblind and score readers
steps.description: Per-reader and pooled accuracy, mean-probability and majority-vote pair calls, Fleiss kappa between readers, calibration; primary result on the PIK3CA-matched set, with PIK3CA-WT-only and stage-matched subsets.

steps.title: Compare readers with slide model
steps.description: Reader vs ABMIL pairwise accuracy on shared pairs, their correlation, and whether combining them helps; adjust for the blinded grade features as before.

steps.title: Write figure and report
steps.description: One summary figure and an updated report covering all four follow-ups, with coverage limits carried into every number.

desired_outputs: PIK3CA-matched pair table and three reader field archives
Three-reader results table with agreement statistics
Pathologist spot-check PDF packet, grading sheet and scoring script
ABMIL out-of-fold predictions and reader-vs-model comparison

feasibility.rationale: I can't act as a pathologist myself, so that step produces a blinded spot-check packet for a human pathologist, plus the scoring code to run once their scores come back. The model step depends on the Phikon+UNI embedding run that another session already has going on Modal (it covers 108 of the 116 pairs); training the model needs one small Modal job of about $0.50, which I'll quote and wait for your approval before launching.
